digest.component_or_area: Jira DC outbound sync: parent field handling via Epic Link path
propositions: A sub-task's parent clear (setting parent=None) can be routed through the Epic Link path instead of the blocked parent field, provided the parent is rebar-managed via a priming local edit.
DC 8.17.1 does successfully clear the Epic Link field when sent {epic_link_field_id: None}, as verified by two green cells in live run 30951453979.
The outbound clear cell was red because DC returns 400 when rebar tries to clear a sub-task's parent field directly, but the Epic Link fallback path remains reachable as the correct re-home.

The managed-ref gate (should_propagate_removal) requires that the parent be established through a local rebar edit in a priming pass to ensure rebar is recognized as the manager before the clear is propagated.

test_outbound_set_subtask_parent_round_trips addresses a different blocker (DC platform limitation on sub-task reparent writes) and must be re-homed separately under a different ticket's operator ruling, not xfailed.
